subject: Pavement and Sidewalk Management Plan Update
overview: The committee met to receive an update from the Department of Public Works on Medford's pavement and sidewalk management plans, reviewing infrastructure conditions, funding targets, and potential staffing for an in-house paving crew. No formal legislative action was taken.

items.title: Pavement and Sidewalk Management Plan Update
items.summary: DPW Commissioner Tim McGivern and City Engineer Owen Wartella presented an update on city street and sidewalk conditions, noting that maintaining network standards requires roughly $8.5 million annually and advocating for an in-house highway crew costing $400,000 to $700,000 to perform regular patching.
